outcome: Clinical course of COVID-19 in pregnant women (symptomatic/asymptomatic, severity)
cohort: The study included 47 pregnant women admitted to a COVID isolation ward who were closely followed between April 8th and July 7th.
finding: The study observed that COVID-19 appears to be a less fatal disease in pregnant women compared to other coronaviruses, though long-term fetomaternal follow-up evidence is not yet available.
gest_age: Mean gestation of women in the study was 32 weeks (ranging from 10 to 40 weeks).
